plans.idea: Two-column split: the tall phone fills the left column at full height, and the headline-led copy, CTA and legal share one left edge in the right column, so the eye moves phone, message, action from left to right.
Centered vertical stack like the original story: the phone sits centered on top, then a full-width headline block, then a centered CTA pill, with legal as a quiet footer, all on one central axis.

Headline banner first: the copy runs full width across the top as a strong lead-in, and below it the phone anchors the lower left while the CTA and legal stack on a shared left edge at lower right, beside the product.
